gate.title: Formal Source-Authority Decision
gate.purpose: Determine whether any supplied representation has sufficient provenance and approval evidence to control source identity; candidate proximity is explicitly non-authoritative.

governing_rules: Source provenance selects the route; a computed result never selects the source authority.
Lowest colour difference or nearest ATLAS candidate must not be used to infer source identity.
Identity must be resolved and frozen before production routing or production judgement.
The Source Authority Router is experimental/shadow in this pilot.

representation_decisions.reason: An internal-library name and version establish traceability only, not controlling brand approval. No signed approval, governing specification, physical standard, spectral data, or measurement record links this value to the approved brand colour.
missing_resolution_evidence: Brand-owner declaration that the named library record is controlling
Exact library identity and immutable version/reference identifier
Approval record linking that record to Northstar Green
If measurement-derived: physical standard ID, spectral/measurement data and measurement conditions

representation_decisions.reason: The derivation is unknown and no measurement, governing specification, owner approval, or chain of custody establishes this Lab value as authoritative.
missing_resolution_evidence: Origin and derivation of the Lab triplet
Measurement or conversion method and complete conditions
Source document/version and chain of custody
Brand-owner approval identifying this Lab value as controlling

representation_decisions.reason: The colour space and code values are explicit, but the web-system provenance does not establish controlling brand authority and no owner approval identifies this encoding as the master definition.
missing_resolution_evidence: Brand-owner declaration that sRGB IEC 61966-2-1 is controlling
Signed approval of the exact 8-bit RGB/HEX values
Governing specification/version and intended scope of use

representation_decisions.representation: HEX #00A651 with undeclared RGB colour space
representation_decisions.reason: HEX code values without a declared RGB colour space are not a complete colour definition; no provenance or approval establishes authority.
missing_resolution_evidence: Explicit RGB colour-space/profile declaration
Encoding rules and bit depth
Source document/version and chain of custody
Brand-owner approval identifying this representation as controlling

representation_decisions.reason: Device values without ICC profile, printing condition, substrate and conversion policy are incomplete. CMYK production values do not establish source identity merely by being supplied.
missing_resolution_evidence: ICC output profile or fully documented printing condition
Substrate, process, ink set and screening details
Rendering intent and black-point-compensation policy where applicable
Evidence of the source reference from which the CMYK values were derived
Brand-owner approval and explicit declaration if this device condition is intended to control

representation_decisions.reason: The artwork encoding is reproducible but has no approval record or governing provenance demonstrating that the artwork instance, rather than another supplied representation, controls the brand colour.
missing_resolution_evidence: Approved master-artwork identifier and immutable version/hash
Brand-owner approval linking that artwork to the controlling colour definition
Statement that embedded/declared sRGB code values govern source identity

referenced_physical_standard.description: Approved physical 2024 sample referenced in the brief
missing_resolution_evidence: Physical sample identifier and custody/location
Signed approval and approval date
Spectral reflectance or verified measurement data
Instrument, calibration, geometry, illuminant, observer, backing and measurement date
Acceptance tolerances and intended production conditions

candidate_result_separation.statement: Neither agreement within a route nor proximity to an ATLAS row is provenance. Gate 3 results therefore have no authority-selection effect.

brand_owner_question.primary_question_de: Welche der sechs gelieferten Repräsentationen – oder welcher bislang nicht gelieferte physische beziehungsweise digitale Master – ist die verbindliche Farbdefinition für Northstar Green, und welcher freigegebene Nachweis belegt diese Autorität?
required_answer_content: Eindeutige Benennung genau einer kontrollierenden Quelle oder eine ausdrücklich definierte Hierarchie
Unveränderliche Quellenkennung, Version und gegebenenfalls Datei-Hash
Schriftliche Freigabe durch den zuständigen Brand Owner
Vollständige Farbraum-, Mess- oder Produktionsbedingungen passend zum gewählten Quellentyp
Geltungsbereich der Freigabe und verbindliche Toleranzen

conditional_follow_up_de.physical_standard: Wenn das physische 2024-Muster kontrolliert: Bitte Muster-ID, Standort/Chain of Custody, Spektral- oder Messdaten, Messgeometrie, Illuminant/Beobachter, Instrument/Kalibrierung, Messdatum und unterzeichnete Freigabe liefern.
conditional_follow_up_de.lab: Wenn ein Lab-Wert kontrolliert: Bitte exakten Wert, Weißpunkt/Beobachter, Herkunft beziehungsweise Mess- oder Umrechnungsmethode, Quelldokument-Version und unterzeichnete Freigabe bestätigen.
conditional_follow_up_de.srgb_or_artwork: Wenn sRGB oder Artwork kontrolliert: Bitte sRGB IEC 61966-2-1, die exakten 8-Bit-RGB/HEX-Werte, die maßgebliche Datei samt Version/Hash und die unterzeichnete Freigabe bestätigen.
conditional_follow_up_de.named_library: Wenn der Named-Colour-Eintrag kontrolliert: Bitte Bibliothek, unveränderliche Version/Datensatz-ID und die Freigabe dieses Datensatzes als Brand Master angeben.
conditional_follow_up_de.cmyk: Wenn CMYK ausdrücklich kontrollieren soll: Bitte ICC-Profil beziehungsweise Druckbedingung, Substrat, Prozess, Inkset, Rendering-Regeln, maßgebliche Referenz und Freigabe liefern; die Geräteabhängigkeit ist ausdrücklich zu bestätigen.

prohibited_inferences: Do not select R01, R02, R03 or R06 because its ATLAS candidate has the smallest colour difference.
Do not treat the R03/R06 numeric match as proof of brand authority.
Do not infer that the named-colour library supersedes owner approval.
Do not invent an RGB space for R04 or production conditions for R05.
Do not assign or freeze any ATLAS row until authority evidence is resolved.
next_permitted_action: Obtain and audit the Brand Owner response and supporting evidence; only then may a separate source-authority resolution and freeze record be created.
result: P02 Gate 4 is complete as a formal unresolved-authority decision. No representation and no ATLAS candidate is frozen.
